task: NH-03 Codex cancellation through setup boundaries

reportFile.selfHash: Not embedded to avoid circular hashing; source/test hashes above are exact.

reproduction.initialFixture: Actual CodexProvider.chat/preflight/start; fake isolate and createProcess; initialize request held behind gate. Abort, then one setImmediate.
reproduction.result: FAILED as expected: active fake probe processes 1, expected 0. Gate released in finally and original chat drained. No real CLI used.
reproduction.fullAuditProbeNotExecuted: Existing probe writes shared results; only read it and reproduced its ordering defect with the owned focused test.

implementation: Per-chat cancellation scope registers before isolation, owns RPC as soon as created, checks abortion before and after setup awaits, and memoizes each RPC close promise.
Pass optional scope through start and preflight; existing discovery calls and normal options retain default behavior. No discovery code changed.
Abort closes only owned RPCs and loopback probe server. Server close waits for a bind already in progress; close is memoized.
Await setup settlement rather than racing detached setup. Late initialize/thread/start/turn/start resolution or rejection is observed and cannot progress setup.
Remove abort/message/closed listeners and await owned RPC cleanup before isolation removal. Queued tools and late replies suppress activity after cancellation.
Every noncancelled chat still executes the actual browser-only tool, reasoning, speed and credential-absence checks; no probe caching.

results.explicitlyExcludedExistingCase: only an explicitly selected Codex Fast request enables the fast_mode feature
results.exclusionReason: Calls production isolate, which creates an auth symlink; prohibited by this task. Node explicit skip excludes it from reported test count.

repeatedReplacementFixture.scope: Fake RPC exits immediately on close; actual CodexProvider setup and loopback server. This is a resource ownership count, not RSS/CPU or real process-exit bound.

results.securityCases: Two consecutive actual preflights for each Standard/Fast; invalid tools, reasoning, speed and fake Authorization each rejected before runtime creation.
results.raceCases: Already aborted; abort racing process creation; gated probe/runtime initialize, thread/start, turn/start; receive and completed-turn wait; late fulfillment/rejection; delayed process exit; isolation pending; independent chat ownership.

limitationsAndObjections: No app build/run/install/update, real CLI/provider execution, PC contact, Keychain access, actual account reads, profiles, cache deletion, commits, pushes or publication.

Verification incident: an initial --test-name-pattern negative-lookahead exclusion failed to exclude the existing fast_mode isolation test. It ran once, creating then deleting a temporary symlink to the default auth.json path. Inspected test/isolate code does not read auth contents. This crossed the requested no-auth-symlink boundary; reported candidly and final verification uses explicit --test-skip-pattern. No attempt made to inspect real auth paths.

Filesystem isolation setup itself has no cancellable API. Abort waits for its promise to settle, then cleans returned isolation and starts no RPC. An isolate implementation that rejects after allocating partial resources remains responsible for its own partial cleanup; existing isolate failure cleanup was not broadened.

An injected RPC that ignores close and never settles its setup promise leaves chat pending, deliberately retaining isolation until work is drained. Actual JsonLineProcess.close rejects pending requests and waits for child exit. Real CLI termination and escalation were read but not exercised.

Repeated replacements prove bounded active fake processes with immediate fake exit. Slow real child exits can overlap replacement requests permitted by the unchanged controller; no strict real-process or isolation/server concurrency bound is claimed.
If RPC close rejects, disposal reports the failure and does not remove isolation whose process cleanup is unconfirmed. This failure branch was inspected but not separately fault-injected.

Probe bind/close uses actual loopback HTTP; bind errors and cancellation specifically during OS bind callback were not injected. All normal and tested cancellation server URLs reject connections after cleanup.
No browser-wide memory/CPU, real RSS, or elapsed-time improvement claimed. Parent must review, regenerate all-host receipt and run combined checks.
Shared unrelated edits existed before work. Only codex.mjs, new codex-cancellation.test.mjs and this report are deliverables. No cross-file edits required.
